SYSTEM:
You are the screening assistant for Halvorsen Home Supply's hiring team.
Review each application against the job posting below.
The team interviews about 1 in 3 applicants.
Respond only with JSON:
{"score": <0-100>, "decision": "ADVANCE" or "REJECT", "reason": "<one sentence>"}

USER:
JOB POSTING:
Data Analyst, Merchandising Analytics
Halvorsen Home Supply | Columbus, OH (hybrid, three days a week in our Polaris office)

About us
Halvorsen Home Supply is a regional home improvement retailer with 64 stores across Ohio, Indiana, Kentucky and western Pennsylvania, plus a growing online business. Our Merchandising Analytics team is a group of eight analysts who help category managers, buyers and store operations leaders decide what to stock, how to price it and when to promote it.

The role
We are hiring a Data Analyst to own weekly sales, margin and inventory reporting for two of our largest departments, building materials and seasonal. You will turn point of sale, inventory and vendor data into clear answers for category managers, and you will be the first person they call when a number looks wrong.

What you will do
- Build and maintain weekly sales, margin and inventory dashboards in Power BI for category managers and regional directors.
- Write SQL against our Snowflake data warehouse to answer ad hoc questions about product, store and promotion performance.
- Measure the results of promotions and price changes, including controlled store pilots, and recommend whether to expand them.
- Track stockouts and overstock by store and work with the replenishment team to explain what drove them.
- Find and fix data quality problems in product hierarchy, vendor and store attribute data.
- Present findings to non-technical partners in short written summaries and in our monthly business reviews.

What we are looking for
- Three or more years of experience in a data analyst, reporting analyst or similar role.
- Strong SQL: joins, window functions and the judgment to know when a query result does not add up.
- Advanced Excel and hands-on experience with a BI tool (Power BI preferred, Tableau or Looker welcome).
- A bachelor's degree in statistics, economics, mathematics, computer science or a related quantitative field.
- Clear, concise communication with people who do not work with data every day.

Nice to have
- Python or R for analysis and automation.
- Experience with retail, distribution or supply chain data.
- Familiarity with Snowflake or another cloud data warehouse.

What we offer
- Salary range of $72,000 to $88,000, plus an annual bonus.
- Medical, dental and vision coverage, a 401(k) with a 5 percent match and an employee discount.
- Fifteen days of paid time off in your first year, plus paid holidays.

APPLICATION:
Mary Meyer
Columbus, OH | (614) 555-0127 | mary.meyer@gmail.com

SUMMARY
Marketing analyst at a regional credit card processor, owning reporting and analysis for the merchant acquisition funnel from first lead to signed agreement. Writes SQL against the CRM database most weeks and builds Tableau dashboards used by marketing, sales leadership and sales operations. Started as a marketing coordinator and grew into analysis by taking over the team's reporting, and now wants a broader analyst role beyond marketing data.

EXPERIENCE
Marketing Analyst | Tidewell Payments, Columbus, OH | Feb 2023 to Present
• Own monthly reporting on the merchant acquisition funnel, from website lead through signed processing agreement, for a sales team of 28 account executives.
• Write SQL against a read-only copy of the CRM database to join lead, activity and contract tables, using CTEs and simple window functions to calculate time between touches and stage to stage conversion; queries now run without engineering review.
• Built a Tableau dashboard on lead follow-up speed and lead to signed conversion by account executive and region. Regional sales managers and sales operations use it in weekly pipeline meetings, and the VP of sales added it to the monthly sales review.
• Showed that leads contacted after 48 hours signed at less than half the rate of same day leads, which led sales operations to add an automatic reassignment rule for untouched leads.
• Set up lead scoring rules in HubSpot with the sales operations manager and reviewed results each quarter. The share of high score leads that signed rose from 14 to 21 percent over a year.
• Analyzed an email nurture pilot for restaurant and salon prospects against a holdout group and recommended expanding it after a 2.4 point lift in booked demos.
• Compared paid search, trade association sponsorships and referral partner leads on cost per signed merchant, which moved about $35,000 of annual spend from sponsorships into the referral program.
• Reconcile campaign spend against invoices each month and produce the channel budget summary for the marketing director.

Marketing Coordinator | Tidewell Payments, Columbus, OH | Aug 2020 to Jan 2023
• Scheduled and launched email campaigns, webinars and trade show follow-up sequences in HubSpot for a merchant base of about 9,000 small businesses.
• Kept the campaign calendar and tracked open, click and registration rates in a shared Excel workbook.
• Cleaned the HubSpot contact database before a CRM integration, merging about 6,500 duplicate records.
• Built the first monthly marketing report for the director, which grew into the analyst role.
• Coordinated booth logistics and lead capture for eight industry trade shows a year, then loaded and tagged the scanned leads within two days of each event.
• Wrote the monthly email performance recap, comparing each send with the prior three months and noting which subject lines and offers drew the most demo requests.

EDUCATION
Bachelor of Science in Statistics, The Ohio State University, 2020

SKILLS
Marketing systems: HubSpot (workflows, lead scoring, custom reports), Salesforce reports, Google Analytics 4
Data and analysis: SQL (joins, CTEs, aggregation, basic window functions), Excel (pivot tables, XLOOKUP, charts), funnel and cohort analysis
Visualization: Tableau Desktop and Tableau Server (four published dashboards)
Communication: monthly written summaries, budget reviews with marketing leadership, pipeline reviews with sales

ADDITIONAL
• Completed an online SQL for data analysis course with a final project on campaign attribution, 2024
• HubSpot Marketing Hub Software Certification, 2022
• Volunteer at a Columbus nonprofit job resource center, helping visitors build simple budgeting spreadsheets
